btcAccountType.recommendation: Not sure? Use Native SegWit (bc1…) — it has the lowest fees and is supported by every modern wallet and exchange.
btcAccountType.explainer: All three hold real bitcoin from the same recovery phrase — they are different address formats, not different wallets, and switching between them never puts funds at risk. Native SegWit (bc1…) costs the least to spend. SegWit (3…) is a middle ground for older services that reject bc1 addresses. Legacy (1…) is the original format: it works everywhere but costs the most in fees. If you are receiving from a service that rejects your address, pick the format it accepts — your coins stay accessible under all three.
